title: One Claude Skills Finds Your Cheapest Cruise & Flight (steal this)
description:
Comment “cruise” for the I Need Cruise skill pack and playbook!

Google Flights makes comparing flights easy.

There’s nothing like it for cruises.
So you guess.

One command fixes that.

It asks your dates and your ideal trip, pulls cruise data through Apify, then cross-checks the Google Flights scraper.

Cheapest cruise and flight, together.

Short list, full list, booking link.

We both know you need a vacation, fam.
